    "\n",
    "# 1. Revenue grouping by product category\n",
    "revenue_by_category = df.groupby('product_category')['revenue'].sum()\n",
    "\n",
    "#2. Create a Pie Chartplt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))\n",
    "revenue_by_category.plot(\n",
    "    kind='pie', \n",
    "    autopct='%1.1f%%', \n",
    "    startangle=140,     \n",
    "    shadow=False    \n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. إعدادات العنوان والشكل\n",
    "plt.title('Revenue distribution by product category', fontsize=14, pad=20)\n",
    "plt.ylabel('')  \n",
    "\n",
    "# 4. عرض الرسم البياني\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "4b6ba3cb-7c74-4b0b-b430-4f3a1d781a8f",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [

     "output_type": "display_data"

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# Set a clean and nice style for the plots\n",
    "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create a figure with an appropriate size\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create the Box Plot\n",
    "# x: Categorical variable (horizontal)\n",
    "# y: Numerical variable (vertical)\n",
    "# data: DataFrame\n",
    "chart = sns.boxplot(\n",
    "    x='product_category', \n",
    "    y='revenue', \n",
    "    data=df,\n",
    "    palette=\"Set3\",      # Attractive color palette\n",
    "    showfliers=False     # Optionally hide outliers to focus on the box\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Add titles and labels in English\n",

    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Set a clean style for the histogram plot\n",

    "    edgecolor=\"black\"\n",
    ")\n",

    "plt.yticks(fontsize=10)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Display the plot\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"

    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "# Set options to display all columns and rows without truncation\n",
    "pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)\n",
    "pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth', None)\n",
    "pd.set_option('display.width', 1000)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Prepare and format order dates and filter for the last 5000 days\n",
    "df['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['order_date'])\n",
    "max_date = df['order_date'].max()\n",
    "start_date_5000 = max_date - pd.Timedelta(days=5000)\n",
    "filtered_df = df[df['order_date'] >= start_date_5000].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Find the top 5 most frequent customer IDs based on order count\n",
    "top_5_ids = filtered_df['customer_id'].value_counts().head(5).index\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Filter the dataset to include these top 5 customers and drop the 'order_date' column\n",
    "top_5_filtered = filtered_df[filtered_df['customer_id'].isin(top_5_ids)].copy()\n",
    "top_5_filtered = top_5_filtered.drop(columns=['order_date'])\n",
    "\n",
    "# 4. Calculate the order count and mean for numerical columns grouped by customer_id\n",
    "numerical_cols = top_5_filtered.select_dtypes(include='number').columns\n",
    "aggregation_dict = {col: 'mean' for col in numerical_cols if col != 'customer_id'}\n",
    "aggregation_dict['customer_id'] = 'count'  # To count the number of orders\n",
    "\n",
    "# Group by customer_id, compute averages, and rename the count column to order_count\n",
    "top_5_averages = top_5_filtered.groupby('customer_id').agg(aggregation_dict).rename(columns={'customer_id': 'order_count'}).reset_index()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 5. Sort the table by order_count in descending order (most orders first)\n",
    "top_5_averages = top_5_averages.sort_values(by='order_count', ascending=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reorder columns to put 'order_count' right after 'customer_id'\n",
    "cols = ['customer_id', 'order_count'] + [col for col in top_5_averages.columns if col not in ['customer_id', 'order_count']]\n",
    "top_5_averages = top_5_averages[cols]\n",
    "\n",
    "# 6. Print the results clearly\n",
    "print(\"Average values and order counts for the top 5 customers, sorted by order count:\")\n",
    "print(top_5_averages.to_string(index=False))"
   ]
  },

    "pd.set_option('display.width', 1000)\n",

    "df['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['order_date'])\n",
    "max_date = df['order_date'].max()\n",
    "start_date_5000 = max_date - pd.Timedelta(days=5000)\n",
    "filtered_df = df[df['order_date'] >= start_date_5000].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Select only the top 4 product categories based on total revenue\n",
    "top_4_categories = filtered_df.groupby('product_category')['revenue'].sum().nlargest(4).index\n",
    "filtered_df = filtered_df[filtered_df['product_category'].isin(top_4_categories)]\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Create a Pivot Table: Categories as Rows, Regions as Columns, Total Revenue as Values\n",
    "region_category_pivot = filtered_df.pivot_table(\n",
    "    index='product_category',\n",
    "    columns='region',\n",
    "    values='revenue',\n",
    "    aggfunc='sum',\n",
    "    fill_value=0\n",

    "# Print the detailed distribution table\n",

    "ax = region_category_pivot.plot(\n",

    "    colormap='tab10',\n",

    "    alpha=0.9\n",

    "plt.ylabel('Total Revenue', fontsize=12, labelpad=10)\n",

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Prepare and filter data for the last 5000 days\n",
    "df['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['order_date'])\n",
    "max_date = df['order_date'].max()\n",
    "start_date_5000 = max_date - pd.Timedelta(days=5000)\n",
    "filtered_df = df[df['order_date'] >= start_date_5000].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. If you want to check correlation at the customer level (Order Count vs Total Revenue per Customer)\n",
    "customer_summary = filtered_df.groupby('customer_id').agg(\n",
    "    order_count=('customer_id', 'count'),\n",
    "    total_revenue=('revenue', 'sum')\n",
    ").reset_index()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient\n",
    "correlation = customer_summary['order_count'].corr(customer_summary['total_revenue'])\n",
    "print(f\"Correlation Coefficient between Order Count and Total Revenue: {correlation:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Plotting the Scatter Plot to visualize the relationship\n",
    "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "sns.scatterplot(\n",
    "    data=customer_summary, \n",
    "    x='order_count', \n",
    "    y='total_revenue', \n",
    "    alpha=0.6, \n",
    "    color='royalblue'\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Add a regression trend line\n",
    "sns.regplot(\n",
    "    data=customer_summary, \n",
    "    x='order_count', \n",
    "    y='total_revenue', \n",
    "    scatter=False, \n",
    "    color='darkred'\n",
    ")\n",

   "source": [
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Prepare and format order dates and filter for the last 5000 days\n",
    "df['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['order_date'])\n",
    "max_date = df['order_date'].max()\n",
    "start_date_5000 = max_date - pd.Timedelta(days=5000)\n",
    "filtered_df = df[df['order_date'] >= start_date_5000].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Select only numerical columns for correlation analysis\n",
    "numerical_df = filtered_df.select_dtypes(include='number')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate the correlation matrix\n",
    "correlation_matrix = numerical_df.corr()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Set up the matplotlib figure and style\n",
    "sns.set_theme(style=\"white\")\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create the Heatmap\n",
    "sns.heatmap(\n",
    "    correlation_matrix, \n",
    "    annot=True,              # Display correlation values inside the cells\n",
    "    fmt=\".2f\",               # Format values to 2 decimal places\n",
    "    cmap='coolwarm',         # Diverging color map (blue for negative, red for positive)\n",
    "    linewidths=0.5,          # Grid lines between cells\n",
    "    cbar_kws={'label': 'Correlation Coefficient'},\n",
    "    vmin=-1, \n",
    "    vmax=1\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# 4. Add titles and formatting in English\n",
    "plt.title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Variables (Last 5000 Days)', fontsize=15, pad=20, fontweight='bold')\n",
    "plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)\n",
    "plt.yticks(fontsize=10)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Display the plot\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
